passages.title: Technology in Modern Education
passages.text: Traditional classrooms are becoming dynamic learning spaces thanks to the crucial role that technology has played in modern education. Technology provides a variety of ways to engage and learn, from virtual reality simulations and interactive whiteboards to online learning environments and instructional applications. It gives pupils instant access to a multitude of knowledge, encouraging critical thinking and self-directed investigation. Adaptive software and data analytics have made it easier to create personalised learning experiences that are catered to each learner's unique speed and learning preferences. Technology helps teachers by streamlining administrative duties, enabling group projects, and creating new teaching opportunities. Despite ongoing worries about digital distractions and fair access, technology's unquestionable strength is its capacity to improve accessibility, engagement, and relevance to 21st-century learning needs.

आधार पर किया जाएगा।

Each question given below consists of a statement, followed by two arguments numbered I and II. You
have to decide which of the arguments is a 'strong' argument and which is a 'weak' argument.
Statement : Should free healthcare be provided to all citizens regardless of income?
Argument I : Yes, healthcare is a basic right and should be accessible to all.
Argument II : No, it will put excessive financial pressure on the government.

तर्कक एक 'मजबूत' तर्कक है और कौन सा 'कमजोर' तर्कक है।
